verdict.reason: The fail-to-pass test fails only because PathAccessError.path holds the internal TType path representation instead of a glom.Path instance (assertion `type(path) is Path`); wrapping the internal path in Path at the construction sites fixes it, and the interface (Path, PathAccessError with .path/.exc/.part_idx) is already public. A capable engineer can derive this from a described symptom.
verdict.unchecked_changes: The test only exercises the index/`[` access branch of _t_eval (via the string spec 'data.3'). The equivalent wrapping changes in _s_first_magic and the '.' (getattr) and 'P' (fuzzy/Path) branches of _t_eval are not directly exercised by the new test, though they are the same one-line change.
verdict.title: PathAccessError.path should be a glom.Path instance
